summary: security-sbom L2 claim is not yet honest because the generated artifact does not contain the repository file inventory that the claim notes assert; it only uses file hashes to derive serialNumber and emits package-manifest components.

validation_results.command: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const p of ['docs/claims/matrix.json','evidence/hosted/security-sbom-2026-07-18.json']) JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')); console.log('json ok')"

findings.claim: docs/claims/matrix.json security-sbom notes claim a reproducible SBOM with sha256 file inventory.
findings.observed: evidence/hosted/security-sbom-2026-07-18.json contains metadata, npm manifest components, and dependency entries, but no emitted files/repository_inventory array for the 381 hashed files reported by the generator.
findings.impact: The L2 evidence overstates repository SBOM coverage. Deterministic generation is proven, but the artifact is not a checkable repository file inventory.
findings.recommended_fix: Either emit the sorted file inventory with sha256 values in the SBOM artifact and update tests to assert it, or lower/clarify the claim to package-manifest-only SBOM evidence.

remaining_risks: No live vulnerability scanner evidence reviewed.
No live IAM apply evidence reviewed for this security-sbom claim.
